display_long_description:
You wake inside Labyrinth Zero: a place that rebuilds itself behind your back, where the only light is the one in your hand.

EVERY FEAR HAS ITS OWN ROOM Ten psychological horror scenarios that escalate from unease to panic: total darkness, whispering radios, figures that only move when you stop looking at them.

A CITY IN THE FOG Walk streets swallowed by the mist and realize something has been following you. Find the hidden bombs and set traps before it reaches you.

FOUR BOSSES, FOUR WAYS TO DIE The Mutant only understands the language of the pipe. The Scavenger hunts you through a fog maze. The Lizard can't even be touched: turn its own charge against it. And the armored Crab only bleeds while its claw is stuck in the sand.

THE STATION No weapons. No tricks. Just an endless platform and something that never stops walking toward you.

• Full 3D spatial audio: hear exactly where it comes from • Physical flashlight, grabbable objects and melee combat • A score system that unlocks new zones • Voices and text in English and Spanish • Different music and scares on every run

Labyrinth Zero is not a corridor of jump scares: it is a place that learns how you get scared. Walk in with your flashlight charged.
